# ui

```go [ui.go]
import "github.com/takoterm/tako/internal/ui"
```

Package ui provides UI components

Package ui provides the raw terminal runner for Tako dev tools.

## Constants

<a name="Reset"></a>Common ANSI escape sequences used across dev tools.

```go [ui.go]
const (
    Reset   = "\033[0m"
    Bold    = "\033[1m"
    Faint   = "\033[2m"
    White   = "\033[38;2;255;255;255m"
    BrandBg = "\033[48;2;199;119;93m"
)
```

<a name="BrandColor"></a>BrandColor is the primary color used for Tako branding.

```go [ui.go]
const BrandColor = "#C7775D"
```

<a name="BrandColorANSI"></a>BrandColorANSI is the ANSI escape sequence for the brand color.

```go [ui.go]
const BrandColorANSI = "\033[38;2;199;119;93m"
```

<a name="Logo"></a>Logo is the ASCII art logo for Tako.

```go [ui.go]
const Logo = ` ___ ____ _  _ ____
  |  |--| |-:_ [__]
`
```

<a name="Model"></a>
## type [Model](<https://github.com/takoterm/tako/blob/main/internal/ui/term.go#L24-L28>)

Model is the interface that dev tools implement.

```go [term.go]
type Model interface {
    Init() Cmd
    Update(msg Msg) (Model, Cmd)
    View() string
}
```
